title: Ayah Paling Sado
subject: a 54-year-old school gardener from Alor Setar in the over-50 masters category of the Kedah state bodybuilding championship, spray-tanned the colour of teh tarik by his wife backstage, his children holding up a banner reading 'Ayah Paling Sado', placing third out of three entrants and lifting the trophy anyway
caption: Afroswing in the UK Afrobeats-rap style, sung and half-rapped in Malay. A syncopated Afrobeats drum groove with a muted kick, crisp rimshots and a busy shaker; congas and a talking drum adding fills; a clean electric guitar playing short palm-muted highlife licks; a warm, rounded sub bass sliding under the chords; soft Rhodes chords. Smooth, warm, spacious mix, percussion crisp and forward, bass deep but soft. Male vocal in a relaxed mid baritone, melodic half-rapped verses with a grin in the voice and a smooth sung hook. 102 BPM, G minor. Cocky, sunny and self-mocking. No trap hi-hat rolls, no amapiano log drum, no reggaeton dembow, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - shaker, congas and a palm-muted guitar lick]

[Verse 1]
Siang aku tukang kebun sekolah
Malam angkat besi kat gim Alor Setar
Dua tahun makan dada ayam rebus
Nasi lemak aku tengok dari jauh je

[Pre-Chorus]
Belakang pentas, orang rumah sembur warna
"Bang, warna dah macam teh tarik, cukuplah"

[Chorus]
Umur lima puluh empat, naik pentas
Seluar hijau, badan berkilat
Budak dua puluh tahun pun pandang dua kali
Senyum, Jamal, pusing belakang

[Verse 2]
MC sebut nama aku "Jamil"
Satu dewan gelak, aku lambai juga
Anak-anak angkat sepanduk depan sekali
Tulis besar-besar, "Ayah Paling Sado"

[Chorus]
Umur lima puluh empat, naik pentas
Seluar hijau, lutut bunyi "krek"
Budak dua puluh tahun pun pandang dua kali
Senyum, Jamal, tahan perut

[Bridge - drums drop out, congas and bass only]
Kategori Master, tiga orang je masuk
Aku dapat nombor tiga, tapi piala tetap piala

[Chorus - full groove returns]
Umur lima puluh empat, turun pentas
Orang rumah lap minyak kat dahi aku
"Esok potong rumput, jangan nak berlagak"
Nombor tiga dari tiga, piala atas kepala

[Outro - guitar lick and shaker, fading]
